name: Telegram Caption/Post Manager Bot
description: A Telegram bot that edits captions and manages/deletes posts across channels, with job tracking and keep-alive support.

OWNER_ID.description: Your personal Telegram numeric user ID (get from @userinfobot). The bot ignores every user except this one.

RUN_MODE.description: Leave as 'webhook' for Heroku (default). Only set to 'polling' for environments without a public URL, like Google Colab.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: The public base URL Heroku assigns to this app, e.g. https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com (no trailing slash). Update this after the app is created if the auto-filled value doesn't match your final app name.

WEBHOOK_PATH.description: Path segment Telegram will POST updates to. Keep the default unless you have a reason to change it.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random secret string used to validate that incoming webhook requests are actually from Telegram.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string. Create a free project at https://neon.tech and paste its connection string here.

SCRATCH_CHAT_ID.description: A private GROUP chat ID where the bot is admin, used only as a throwaway destination for reading captions via forwardMessage. See README for setup steps.
